narratives.body: Report_1 states a French-born forward eligible for the Super Falcons has joined Chelsea on a professional deal. Report_2 indicates Chelsea plans a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Report_9 and Report_19 claim Chelsea is being labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City, citing 114 guilty charges. Report_11 and Report_8 note that Emi Martinez has confirmed a new aim after surgery and revealed an injury timeline. Report_13 attributes the 'bigger and worse offenders' claim to Simon Jordan. Report_21 urges a player with 23 minutes of playing time to leave the club. Report_12 reports former Berekum midfielder Bediako moving to Atletico.
narratives.headline: Chelsea transfer news, disciplinary claims and injury updates
